effective profile, tool/model version, and review status.

Prepared for: Mohamed TAIEB    |    Date: 22 October 2026
Important: this report presents a technical architecture and assurance-support concept. It does not claim that an LLM output
alone demonstrates certification compliance. Final compliance decisions, evidence acceptance, and tool qualification
considerations remain under controlled engineering and certification processes.
SmartX Agentic AI Architecture - Technical Vision Report
Page 2
Document purpose and assumptions
This report explains how to build a production-oriented SmartX platform that can receive engineering

The central design decision is the SmartX Canonical JSON. Every stage receives a versioned JSON
envelope and produces another versioned JSON envelope. This isolates file-format complexity from
business logic, enables replay and auditing, and lets the same validation or traceability agent process
artifacts originating from PDF, Word, Excel, XML, source code, or test specifications.
Contents
1. Vision and principles
2. Target architecture
3. How the system understands an input
4. JSON Translator design
5. Agentic processing and orchestration
6. LLM, RAG, rules, and configuration
7. Generic DO-178C-oriented and specific GT44 treatment
8. Output generation and traceability
9. Security, assurance, and human oversight
10. Developer architecture and APIs
11. Implementation roadmap and validation strategy
12. Worked example
13. Risks, limitations, and conclusion

Routing policy example
• If schema validation fails, route to translation repair or human mapping; do not call compliance
agents.
• If artifact type is requirement, run requirement-quality rules, relevant project rules, traceability, and
optionally test generation.

POST /v1/files
Upload and register an immutable source file.
POST /v1/jobs
Create a task using a profile and requested operations.
GET /v1/jobs/{id}
Read state, events, pending approvals, and results.
POST /v1/reviews/{id}/decision
Approve, reject, or correct a proposed mapping/finding/link.
GET /v1/artifacts/{id}
Return canonical JSON and provenance.
GET /v1/results/{id}/export
Export an authorized PDF, spreadsheet, DOCX, or JSON
package.
POST /v1/admin/profiles/validate
Validate profile inheritance, rule references, and permissions.
Persistence model
• Object store: immutable originals, rendered pages, and generated deliverables.
• Relational database: jobs, artifacts, relationships, findings, profiles, reviews, and audit events.
• Vector database: authorized chunks and artifact embeddings, partitioned by tenant/profile.
• Event log: every transition, tool call summary, input/output hash, and approval.
